available: Latest available days per product (up to 7)
intro: Explore NASA FIRMS observations. Available dates may precede today; check each product's period.
partial: Incomplete query: some products could not be downloaded. Do not interpret missing data as zero activity.
limits: Read-only query, 15-minute cache, no persistent ingestion. Rectangular area, not an administrative boundary. Satellite coverage is not assessed; history and other views may remain demonstrations.
emptyWarning: Zero records means this query returned no detections; it does not prove absence of fires. The 24-hour, 3-day and 7-day filters are anchored to download time, not an old observation.
empty: No detections returned for this filter and the queried products.
failed: NASA FIRMS could not be queried. Synthetic data is not substituted.
displayLimit: The list shows up to 200 records and the map up to 250 markers. Intensity uses every filtered record.
